title: Canonical track-pack manifest model + UCSC track-hub generator
context: All three browser targets (UCSC, JBrowse 2, IGV) must be kept in sync from a single source of truth to avoid drift; hand-maintaining three parallel configs is error-prone and unsustainable. The solution is a canonical track-pack manifest model that encodes all pack metadata, with browser-specific configs emitted as projections. This task builds the manifest TypeScript model and the UCSC track-hub generator (hub.txt, genomes.txt, trackDb.txt), which is the M0 foundation for all subsequent pack tasks.
objective: Implement the canonical track-pack manifest model and a UCSC track-hub generator that emits a valid, hubCheck-clean hub from a manifest fixture, with golden-fixture CI tests and the attribution + not-medical-advice string embedded in track descriptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest model documents every field from PLAN §6: id, title, description, intendedUse, notMedicalAdvice, assembly{id,source}, coordinateConvention, tracks[]{name,type,file,source{name,release,url,recordIdScheme},license{id,url,permitsRedistribution,nonCommercial,snapshotRef},dataTier,attribution,liftOver{from,to,chain,unmappedCount}}, provenanceCompleteness{score}, riskTier, reviewers{}, hosting{}.
Generator emits a valid UCSC track hub (hub.txt, genomes.txt, trackDb.txt) as a projection of the manifest; hubCheck passes on a golden fixture.
Track description embeds the source attribution and the not-medical-advice/intended-use string.
Golden manifest → expected hub fixtures are committed and diffed in CI using only synthetic fixtures (no bulk source data).
Code is MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; commit is DCO signed-off.
resources: UCSC track-hub spec: hub.txt, genomes.txt, trackDb.txt
output: packages/manifest/src/ — TypeScript manifest model and UCSC hub generator, with packages/manifest/test/ golden fixtures; submitted as a PR.
